notes.title: Achievement art update + Steam Cloud enabled!
notes.content:
We've updated the achievement icons for Blankspace with new art, hope you like them! :)

Additionally, Steam Cloud saves are now enabled! Your existing saves will stay local, but any saves you make after this update will be saved to the cloud, too.

- Nayru

notes.title: The Digital Artbook and Additional Text Patch (18+) are now available on Steam!
notes.content:
The Blankspace Digital Artbook and Additional Text Patch (18+) are now both available on Steam!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1736940/Blankspace__Digital_Artbook_Wallpaper_Pack/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1736950/Blankspace__Additional_Text_Patch_18/

The Blankspace Deluxe Edition (including the game, the soundtrack, and the artbook) is now available at a discount, as well!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/22610/Blankspace__Deluxe_Edition/

A lot of work went into the DLCs, so I hope you guys enjoy the content. :)

Cheers!
- Nayru

notes.title: Blankspace - OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Hey, guys! Blankspace is OUT NOW! °˖✧◝(⁰▿⁰)◜✧˖°

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1228600/Blankspace/
 
We've put a lot of heart and soul into this project and made it the best it could possibly be to the best of our abilities. We dearly hope you'll enjoy the experience!
 
Be sure to leave us an honest review once you play it, too! We'd love to hear your thoughts, and those always help out immensely!

https://i.imgur.com/lLmcAiq.jpg
Art by MstMori
 
Cheers!
- Nayru & Xolf

notes.title: Blankspace Release Date - July 23rd!
notes.content:
Make sure to add Blankspace to your Steam wishlist so that you don't miss it! Those 7 days will pass by faster than you think!

https://i.imgur.com/lM2jh9z.png

After working diligently on this project for over a year (the first ideas blossomed in April 2019, while Beryl and Chris's designs came into existence in June/July 2019), I am super excited to share this project in its complete form with you and the rest of the world.

[previewyoutube=tPafLBCMjhg;full][/previewyoutube]
You can also join us on Twitter and Discord for more frequent updates!

Cheers!
- Nayru

notes.title: The updated demo for Blankspace is now available on Steam!
notes.content:
Updates for the demo include:

 5 original music tracks from Odd (I've swapped out all the old music)
 custom cursor images for hover areas during investigation phases
 minor fixes


https://i.imgur.com/FUj0f6j.png

Please check it out and add the game to your wishlist! You'll be sure not to miss the release date that way - and it will also help me out immensely by making the project more visible on Steam! ٩(°◡°♡)۶

I hope you like it!

- Nayru
